extracted.intended_audience: organizations and applicants seeking FDA grants or cooperative agreements (regulatory partners, prospective grantees)
extracted.subtask_description: Procedural guidance on mandatory registrations and prerequisites that applicant organizations must complete and maintain to be eligible to apply for or receive FDA grants or cooperative agreements. Emphasizes required registries, timelines, and account roles.

rubrics_metrics.name: Registration is a critical step; begin early
rubrics_metrics.description: A critical step to successfully applying for a grant or cooperative agreement is meeting the registration requirements. Registration can take 6 weeks or more, so begin the registration process now.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Start registrations well in advance of deadlines; verify all registrations are up-to-date before submitting an application.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use the same DUNS number across all registrations and application
rubrics_metrics.description: All registrations require that applicants be issued a DUNS number. The same DUNS number must be used for all registrations, as well as on the grant application.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Obtain a DUNS number before beginning SAM and eRA Commons registrations; ensure consistency of DUNS across systems to avoid application processing problems.

rubrics_metrics.name: System for Award Management (SAM) active registration required
rubrics_metrics.description: Applicants must complete and maintain an active registration [in SAM (formerly CCR)], which requires renewal at least annually.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The renewal process may require as much time as the initial registration. SAM registration includes the assignment of a Commercial and Government Entity (CAGE) Code for domestic organizations which have not already been assigned a CAGE Code. Note: SAM replaces CCR; organizations previously registered under CCR must re-register under SAM.

rubrics_metrics.name: eRA Commons registration and required organizational accounts
rubrics_metrics.description: Applicants must have an active DUNS number and SAM registration in order to complete the eRA Commons registration.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Organizations can register with eRA Commons as they are working through their SAM or Grants.gov registration. eRA Commons requires organizations to identify at least one Signing Official (SO) and at least one Program Director/Principal Investigator (PD/PI) account in order to submit an application — ensure these accounts are created and associated correctly.

rubrics_metrics.name: Grants.gov registration prerequisite
rubrics_metrics.description: Applicants must have an active DUNS number and SAM registration in order to complete the Grants.gov registration.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Complete DUNS and SAM steps before or while registering at Grants.gov; Grants.gov is the portal for locating current funding opportunities and submitting applications.

rubrics_metrics.name: Follow the SF 424 (R&R) Application Guide for registration details
rubrics_metrics.description: Applicant organizations must complete and maintain the following registrations as described in the SF 424 (R&R) Application Guide to be eligible to apply for or receive an award.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Consult the SF 424 (R&R) Application Guide for step-by-step instructions and eligibility details; use it as the authoritative source for application and registration requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: SAM replaces CCR — re-register if previously on CCR
rubrics_metrics.description: Please note that SAM now replaces CCR; if you previously registered under CCR, you will need to re-register under SAM for any applications you wish to submit.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Do not assume prior CCR registration is sufficient; complete SAM registration and confirm active status before application submission.

rubrics_metrics.name: Allow time for SAM CAGE code assignment for domestic organizations
rubrics_metrics.description: SAM registration includes the assignment of a Commercial and Government Entity (CAGE) Code for domestic organizations which have not already been assigned a CAGE Code.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Account for any additional processing time related to CAGE code assignment when planning registration timelines.

rubrics_metrics.name: Verify registrations remain current (annual renewal requirement)
rubrics_metrics.description: SAM registration requires renewal at least annually; applicants must complete and maintain active registrations to be eligible.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Set calendar reminders for renewals and periodically verify that all system records (DUNS, SAM, eRA Commons, Grants.gov) are current to avoid application ineligibility.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use FDA and linked resources for opportunity details and past award information
rubrics_metrics.description: Current funding opportunities available to regulatory partners can be found at www.grants.gov. Information regarding past awardees can be found at www.usaspending.gov. For additional food-related opportunities, see Funding Opportunities Provided by Office of Domestic Partnerships.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Consult these linked resources to find open solicitations, check past awards for program fit, and identify program contacts; use the FDA's listed program site contacts for specific contract or grant questions.
